$Comment: Defens-ice v3 (2026-10-21: the shield should last longer and be used when he is taking a lot of damage; it cuts the damage he takes; every hit shortens it, e.g. 8 s, and hitting it a lot cuts 4 s off; the warning only right before it blows). 1) AT_Ice_King_Ice_Shield on himself (70 % less damage, bubble; 12 s so it never expires on its own, only the burst removes it). 2) Hold up to 8 s; every 5 hits he takes (counted by his role: Damage sensor + AT_Ice_King_Shield_Hit_1..4, then AT_Ice_King_Shield_Broken) cut 4 s off, more than once if you keep hitting. 3) Last 1.5 s: red filling circle on the ground. 4) Burst: bubble shatters (its Despawn), AOECircle 5 blocks, AT_Ice_King_Ice_Shield_Burst_Damage (15 ice, push, 2 frost stacks). CAE IceShield (phase 1) prefers it when he has taken a lot of damage recently (RecentSustainedDamage). Rebuild with the script in the 2026-10-21 notes if the timings change: steps x 0.5 s = time, CUT steps = seconds cut x 2. Shield timings (ice-king-shield.py): seconds 8, cut 4, warn 1.5. Rebuilt by scripts/ice-king-shield.py: a hold of 0.5 s steps; after each, AT_Ice_King_Shield_Broken (5 hits) clears the counters and skips 4 s ahead, never past the start of the red warning (hits during the warning change nothing); every step is a Selector that pushes out everything within 3 blocks (Root_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Shield_Push, no damage); red warning in the last 1.5 s; shield effect 12 s. 2026-10-22 sounds: SFX_AT_Ice_King_VO_Shield_Cast (a scared gasp) as the shield goes on, on its first step; scripts/ice-king-shield.py copies this step from the file, so a regeneration keeps it.
